sources.purpose: Document the different inverse rotation convention of the sampling region.

preserved_semantics: Static angular-grid kLidar and kCamera endpoint models use direct Rz(yaw)*Ry(pitch)*Rx(roll), followed by center_offset and robot yaw.
Endpoints are [range*cos(h), range*sin(h), range*sin(v)], retaining the original non-spherical vertical convention.
Gain rays start at the robot body position; configured endpoint offsets do not relocate that origin.
Sensor min_range does not clip rays in the upstream volumetric ray-gain branch.
Unknown/free/occupied ray-voxel visits and weighted gain are summed across sensors without overlap deduplication.
Each sensor applies its own frontier normalization and threshold; aggregate frontier is their logical OR.
ros2_adaptations: Named sensor model parameters and exploration sensor selection are declared by the native ROS 2 planner.
The sensor_gain Trigger service exposes per-sensor diagnostics at the latest odometry pose.
Named PointCloud2 inputs, acquisition-time TF lookup, one shared map backend and per-input counters are native mapping adapters.
Input topic configuration is independent from planning sensor geometry; no automatic TF is generated by mapper or planner.
The existing native map-ray traversal and map bounds remain in use.
scope: Static sensor models, two independent cloud inputs, occupancy/TSDF mapping and one native local plan. Dynamic camera intrinsics and full ROS 1 versus ROS 2 mission equivalence are outside this evidence.
